# TIME

> TIME is a global news magazine and digital journalism platform covering breaking news, politics, world affairs, business, health, science, climate, culture, and opinion.

TIME publishes reported news, analysis, interviews, essays, rankings, and special projects across major public-interest topics. Its site combines daily coverage with recurring franchises, person-of-the-year features, lists, and magazine-style collections.

## Main News Sections
- [Home](https://time.com/): Front page with breaking news, featured stories, and major national and international developments.
- [U.S.](https://time.com/section/us/): Domestic news coverage on policy, society, crime, courts, and public affairs.
- [World](https://time.com/section/world/): International reporting on geopolitics, conflict, diplomacy, and global events.
- [Politics](https://time.com/section/politics/): Coverage of elections, Congress, the White House, campaigns, and government policy.
- [Business](https://time.com/section/business/): Reporting on markets, companies, leadership, technology, and the economy.
- [Tech](https://time.com/section/tech/): News and analysis on AI, platforms, devices, cybersecurity, and digital culture.
- [Entertainment](https://time.com/section/entertainment/): Coverage of film, television, music, celebrities, and pop culture.
- [Sports](https://time.com/section/sports/): Reporting on major leagues, athletes, tournaments, and sports culture.

## Public Affairs and Society
- [Health](https://time.com/section/health/): Reporting on medicine, public health, wellness, research, and health policy.
- [Science](https://time.com/section/science/): Coverage of scientific discoveries, space, biology, and research developments.
- [Climate](https://time.com/section/climate/): Reporting on climate change, energy transition, sustainability, and environmental policy.
- [Education](https://time.com/section/education/): Coverage of schools, higher education, learning policy, and student issues.
- [History](https://time.com/section/history/): Historical essays and context tied to current events and anniversaries.
- [Food](https://time.com/section/food/): Stories on food culture, policy, restaurants, and consumer trends.

## Ideas and Magazine Features
- [Ideas](https://time.com/section/ideas/): Opinion essays and commentary from writers, experts, and public figures.
- [Magazine](https://time.com/magazine/us/): Digital access to TIME magazine issues, cover stories, and feature packages.
- [The Brief](https://time.com/the-brief-newsletter-sign-up/): TIME’s flagship newsletter summarizing major daily news developments.
- [Person of the Year](https://time.com/person-of-the-year/): Archive and current coverage of TIME’s annual Person of the Year franchise.
- [TIME100](https://time.com/time100/): Annual project recognizing influential people across politics, culture, science, and business.
- [TIME100 Next](https://time.com/time100-next/): Profiles of emerging leaders shaping the future across industries and causes.

## Rankings, Lists, and Special Projects
- [TIME100 Most Influential Companies](https://time.com/time100-companies/): Annual list highlighting companies making an outsized global impact.
- [TIME100 Health](https://time.com/time100-health/): Recognition project featuring influential leaders in global health and medicine.
- [TIME100 Climate](https://time.com/time100-climate/): Coverage and profiles focused on influential climate leaders and solutions.
- [Best Inventions](https://time.com/best-inventions/): Annual roundup of notable inventions, products, and technological breakthroughs.
- [Best Places](https://time.com/best-places/): Curated list of destinations and businesses offering exceptional experiences.
- [Women of the Year](https://time.com/women-of-the-year/): Profiles and coverage celebrating influential women across fields.
- [Next Generation Leaders](https://time.com/next-generation-leaders/): Feature series spotlighting rising figures in politics, activism, and culture.

## Newsletters and Audio
- [Newsletters](https://time.com/newsletters/): Directory of TIME newsletters across news, politics, health, and culture topics.
- [The Brief Newsletter Sign-Up](https://time.com/the-brief-newsletter-sign-up/): Sign-up page for TIME’s daily top-news newsletter.
- [Into the Metaverse](https://time.com/into-the-metaverse/): Newsletter and coverage focused on virtual worlds, AI, and emerging tech.
- [TIME Podcasts](https://time.com/podcasts/): Hub for TIME audio programming, interviews, and narrative journalism.
- [Person of the Week](https://time.com/person-of-the-week-podcast/): Podcast featuring conversations tied to major newsmakers and cultural figures.

## Video and Visual Journalism
- [Video](https://time.com/video/): Video hub with interviews, explainers, documentaries, and reported segments.
- [Photography](https://time.com/section/photography/): Photo essays and visual storytelling from news, culture, and history.
- [TIME Studios](https://time.com/time-studios/): Original film, television, and documentary production arm of TIME.
- [Red Border Films](https://time.com/red-border-films/): Documentary and visual storytelling projects produced under TIME’s film banner.

## Events and Live Journalism
- [TIME Events](https://time.com/time-events/): Hub for summits, live conversations, and editorially driven public events.
- [TIME100 Summit](https://time.com/time100-summit/): Event coverage and programming tied to the TIME100 franchise.
- [TIME CO2](https://time.com/time-co2/): Climate-focused event and editorial platform on decarbonization and sustainability.
- [TIME Health](https://time.com/time-health/): Event and editorial initiative focused on health innovation and policy.
- [TIME Women of the Year Gala](https://time.com/women-of-the-year/): Coverage connected to TIME’s Women of the Year recognition program.

## About, Subscription, and Access
- [Subscribe](https://time.com/subscribe-header-time/): Subscription offers for digital and print access to TIME journalism.
- [Customer Care](https://time.com/customerservice/): Help resources for subscriptions, billing, delivery, and account support.
- [About TIME](https://time.com/about/): Overview of TIME’s mission, history, leadership, and editorial organization.
- [Press Room](https://time.com/press-room/): Company announcements, media resources, and corporate news updates.
- [Privacy Policy](https://time.com/privacy-policy/): Privacy practices governing data collection and user information.
- [Terms of Use](https://time.com/terms/): Legal terms covering use of TIME’s website, content, and services.
